SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Consumption > 528.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CustomerID) FROM yearmonth WHERE YEAR(Date) = 2012 AND MONTH(Date) = 2
SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Consumption > 528.3 THEN CustomerID END) AS DECIMAL) * 100 / COUNT(CustomerID) FROM yearmonth WHERE YEAR(Date) = 2012 AND MONTH(Date) = 2

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Consumption > 528.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL) * 100 / COUNT(CustomerID) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '2012-02-01' AND '2012-02-28'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Consumption > 528.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) * 100 / COUNT(CustomerID) FROM yearmonth WHERE YEAR(Date) = 2012 AND MONTH(Date) = 2
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Consumption > 528.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM yearmonth WHERE YEAR(Date) = 2012 AND MONTH(Date) = 2
